_comment: Reviewed licence DECLARATIONS for packages in a built image whose own metadata states no machine-readable licence.
Read by scripts/license-gate-image.mjs only. NOT an exception: the declared licence is then judged by licenses/policy.json like any
other (forbid / copyleft / attribution rules all apply). An entry names an EXACT version, so a bump is re-reviewed; an entry
whose package is not in the image, or whose package now declares a licence itself, is reported as stale and fails the gate.
Every entry: ecosystem, name, version, licence (SPDX), evidence (where the licence text was read), reviewedBy, date.

overrides.name: tiktoken
overrides.evidence: The wheel's METADATA `License` field is the full MIT text ('MIT License  Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI, Shantanu Jain ...'), too long for the gate's short-field rule; same text in tiktoken-0.14.0.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.
overrides.reviewedBy: owner approval 2026-11-24 (prepared in the litellm-oss PR)

overrides.name: cryptography/openssl
overrides.evidence: OpenSSL statically linked into the cryptography 50.0.0 wheel (its SBOM lists the component without a licence). OpenSSL 3.0 and later is Apache-2.0 (https://www.openssl.org/source/license.html), the same text as cryptography-50.0.0.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.APACHE.
overrides.reviewedBy: owner approval 2026-11-24 (prepared in the litellm-oss PR)

overrides.name: precond
overrides.evidence: package.json declares no licence; the package's README.md, section 'License': 'This code is free to use under the terms of the MIT license (http://mturcotte.mit-license.org/)'. Read in the langfuse-oss worker image (a dependency of backoff 2.5.0 in the worker's dependency tree).
overrides.reviewedBy: OWNER APPROVAL PENDING (prepared in the langfuse-oss PR)

overrides.name: posthog-js
overrides.evidence: package.json says 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'. The package's LICENSE (npm tarball posthog-js-1.372.5.tgz, package/LICENSE): Apache-2.0 ('Copyright 2020 Posthog / Hiberly, Inc. Copyright 2015 Mixpanel, Inc. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0', full text), plus MIT for files marked as coming from getsentry/sentry-javascript ('Copyright (c) 2012 Functional Software, Inc. dba Sentry'). In the langfuse-oss web image (Langfuse's MIT client code imports it; it sends nothing without NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, which the image does not set).
overrides.reviewedBy: OWNER APPROVAL PENDING (prepared in the langfuse-oss PR)
